component.name: Find-Me
component.summary: Instant, offline-first Linux desktop file search inspired by Windows Everything

description.p: Find-Me is an ultra-fast, lightweight Linux desktop search utility written in 100% pure Rust. Inspired by Windows Everything, it indexes millions of local filesystem records into a compact in-memory arena (<45 MB RAM per 1,000,000 files) and evaluates fuzzy and structured Everything-style queries in under 5 milliseconds.

ul.li: 100% Pure Rust stack with hardware-accelerated Iced GUI (Elm architecture, 60 FPS virtualized rendering).
Instant real-time search evaluation via nucleo-matcher fuzzy scoring and SIMD filters.
Everything query syntax support: ext:, size:, dm:, path:, regex:, and boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT).
Real-time filesystem change tracking with Linux inotify kernel events and 150ms debouncing.
Zero-copy memory-mapped disk persistence with SIMD CRC32 validation (cold boot <35ms).
Desktop integration: DBus org.freedesktop.FileManager1 file highlighting, Wayland/X11 clipboard, and POSIX properties inspection.
Power navigation: 100% keyboard operable without touching the mouse.
Zero root/sudo requirements; executes completely within unprivileged user space.

description.p: Initial production release of Find-Me Linux desktop search engine.
